flowchart TD
  Start([User Clicks Forgot Password]) --> InputEmail[Enter Email Address]
  InputEmail --> SystemCheck{Email Exists?}
  
  SystemCheck -->|Yes| SendEmail[Send Reset Email with Token]
  SystemCheck -->|No| ShowErrorEmail[Show Error: Email Not Found]
  ShowErrorEmail --> InputEmail
  
  SendEmail --> UserClick[User Clicks Link in Email]
  UserClick --> ValidateToken{Token Valid & Unexpired?}
  
  ValidateToken -->|No| ShowErrorToken[Show Error: Invalid or Expired Token]
  ShowErrorToken --> EndError([End])
  
  ValidateToken -->|Yes| EnterNewPass[Enter New Password]
  EnterNewPass --> PassMatch{Passwords Match & Strong?}
  
  PassMatch -->|No| ShowErrorPass[Show Error: Invalid Password]
  ShowErrorPass --> EnterNewPass
  
  PassMatch -->|Yes| UpdateDB[Update Password in Database]
  UpdateDB --> Success([Success: Password Reset Complete])

flowchart TD
  Start([Start]) --> Insert[Insert Card]
  Insert --> EnterPIN[Enter PIN]
  EnterPIN --> CheckPIN{PIN Valid?}
  
  CheckPIN -->|No| ErrorPIN[Display Error: Invalid PIN]
  ErrorPIN --> End([End])
  
  CheckPIN -->|Yes| EnterAmount[Enter Withdrawal Amount]
  EnterAmount --> CheckBalance{Sufficient Balance?}
  
  CheckBalance -->|No| ErrorBalance[Display Error: Insufficient Funds]
  ErrorBalance --> End
  
  CheckBalance -->|Yes| Dispense[Dispense Cash]
  Dispense --> Print[Print Receipt]
  Print --> Eject[Eject Card]
  Eject --> End
